objasnjenje_sr: Leme koje se u Marku (DK+SPC) pojave tačno jednom. Ispale iz kandidata zbog MIN_FREQ=2.
generation_rule: hapax := combined token frequency (dk+spc) == 1; no POS filter (CSV has no UPOS); punctuation-only tokens excluded; lemma key = lowercased CSV token. asymmetric_dk_spc marks 1-in-one / 0-in-other (DK↔SPC candidate subset).
note_pos: POS not available from bible_lemmatized.csv without re-running CLASSLA. read_priority approximates content vs function via LEMMA_DROP + length, not UPOS.
note_asymmetric: For combined freq==1, asymmetric_dk_spc is always true by definition (1 in one corpus, 0 in the other). Flag is kept to show WHICH corpus; pair discovery is by reading related hapaxes (e.g. opušćenje dk + opustošenje spc).
